description: Replaces the current todo list with the given list. Use this to plan multi-step work and track progress: keep exactly one task in_progress at a time, mark tasks completed as soon as they are done, and keep the list current rather than batching updates. Each todo needs a content (imperative form, e.g. "Run tests") and activeForm (present continuous form shown while in progress, e.g. "Running tests").
name: TodoWrite
